Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

The viral Brothy rice bowls are sooo savory and cozy and delish!! Made mine with a few extra veg too. Such a great dairy free dinner! Curry Broth * 3 cloves garlic, minced * 1 shallot, finely chopped * 3 tbsp red curry paste * 1 can light coconut milk * 1 cup chicken or beef broth * 3 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * Oil, for cooking Ground Beef & Vegetables * 1 lb ground beef * 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce * 1 zucchini, sliced * 2 cups chopped spinach * Oil, if needed Serving * 2 cups cooked rice * Garnishes: Squeeze of lime, Chili crisp, Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Heat a drizzle of oil in a saucepan. Add garlic and shallot and sauté until fragrant. Add red curry paste and toast for 1 minute. Add coconut milk, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. 2. Brown the ground beef in a skillet with 1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce. Add sliced zucchini and cook until softened. Add chopped spinach and cook for a few more minutes until wilted. 3. Add rice to a bowl, top with the beef and vegetables, and pour the curry broth over everything. Garnish with lime, chili crisp, and sesame seeds.

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

This chicken recipe went viral for a reason… 🤤🍗 Almost 800K views later, and we’re STILL making it every Sunday! 😂 At this point, my family just knows what’s for dinner, and honestly, nobody’s complaining! It’s easy, packed with flavor, and turns out AMAZING every single time. Served over mashed potatoes with that delicious gravy?! SO GOOD! 🤌🏼 🍗 VIRAL CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! We love serving ours over mashed potatoes with roasted green beans and honey butter rolls! 🤎 SAVE this for your next Sunday dinner! I promise it’s one you’ll make again and again! Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies.
